title: Paraphrase Evidence Ingest Contract
purpose: Stable input contract for importer lanes that emit source-backed paraphrase candidates. Importers may score and license-check rows, but the final HUD/ranking lane owns aggregation, winner selection, and rendering.
license_policy: Every row must preserve source/version/license metadata. Unclear, commercial-use-restricted, closed-rights, or imported English translation material is not allowed.
hud_consumption_rule: Only candidate_status=accepted rows are consumed by the HUD route store. Proposed rows may be kept for review, but they do not appear as definition cards.

scoring.display_percent: The HUD displays raw_score as the match percent.
scoring.ordering_score: The HUD sorts eligible routes by adjusted_score first, then raw_score, then route family tie-breakers.
scoring.strict_route_comparison: Strict Hebrew, strict Aramaic, and morphology routes use no paraphrase handicap; lemma, subphrase, biblical paraphrase, and citable paraphrase use the same 20 point handicap.

source_evidence_rules: phrase_hebrew must be Hebrew/Aramaic source text from an accepted workbench source row.
phrase_tokens must mark the focus with role=focus-token.
definition is a project-authored paraphrase candidate, not an imported translation.
source_rows must include the source text license row used as evidence.
Importer lanes must not touch HUD rendering, final route sorting, winner selection, or live page files.

source_rows.notes: Project-authored coordination contract only. No external dictionary text or English translation is imported.
